HTTP/2 Stream Adapter

An AsyncStream subtype that maps reads/writes to HTTP/2 DATA frames on a single stream. This allows SSE and WebSocket handlers to work transparently over HTTP/2 — the same handler code works for both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2.

Write: data → connection-scoped HTTP/2 writer callback Read: internal buffer fed by processServerFrame via feedData()
